method.event_rules: Current annual output-decline episodes and original JST core Bry-Boschan peaks are dated on R6 country-year data.
method.common_coverage: 14 original JST countries and event years 1870-2002.
method.exact_match: Same ISO country and event year.
method.outcomes: R6 peak-to-trough decline and 5-year cumulative losses relative to a 5-year pre-event linear trend.
method.regression: Current severity predictors with country and decade fixed effects and country-clustered standard errors.
method.interpretation: Descriptive event construction comparison, not causal policy evidence.
limitations: Original chronology dates come from an older data vintage and are applied to R6 output.
The original JST event count differs from the 121 complete observations in Table 8 because this cohort uses chronology flags before regression complete-case exclusions.
The common-date overlap and unmatched cohorts share event outcomes only when their country and year match exactly.
